answer: The design leans on session-key rotation bound to work, re-queued for a second panel, auditors are drawn from a rotating pool. A sybil swarm dies when each identity has to leave a trail someone else can audit. Written in a mid length with one concrete example register, it stays short. A juniper of per-task receipts records who did what, and the ocean of that record is inspected by auditors who gain nothing from passing it. What survives to the comet is a record of labour, not a list of addresses.
